title: streampay-state verify report (v1)
description: Output of `streampay-state verify --snapshot <file> --format json`. Compatibility policy: within v1 the report is additive-only. Fields and `check` identifiers are never removed, renamed or re-typed; new optional fields and new `check` identifiers may appear, so consumers must ignore unknown properties and tolerate unknown `check` values. Any breaking change ships as json-schema-v2.json with report_version 2.

report_version.description: Version of this contract. Always 1 for this schema.

tool_version.description: Version of the streampay-state binary that produced the report.

ok.description: true exactly when `violations` is empty. The process also exits 0 only in that case.

snapshot.description: Facts about the snapshot file that was verified.

schema_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint recorded in the snapshot file.

expected_schema_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the snapshot schema this verifier build understands. A mismatch with `schema_fingerprint` is reported as a `schema_fingerprint` violation.

counts.description: Number of rows of each kind in the snapshot.

violations.description: Every invariant violation found. Empty when `ok` is true.

unclaimed_by_token.description: Per token, the unclaimed balance (deposit - withdrawn) summed over Active streams. Sorted by `token`. Tokens with no Active stream are omitted.

check.description: Stable identifier of the invariant that failed. Match on this, not on `message`. Consumers must tolerate values not listed here: new checks may be added within v1.

message.description: Human-readable description. Wording is not part of the contract and may change.

unclaimed.description: Decimal integer string. Amounts are i128 and can exceed the JSON/JavaScript safe-integer range, so parse with BigInt, not Number.
